arxiv-2108-13949.title: Latency-Redundancy Tradeoff in Distributed Read-Write Systems
arxiv-2108-13949.creator: Saraswathy Ramanathan 1, Gaurav Gautam 1, Vikram Srinivasan 1, Parimal Parag 1
arxiv-2108-13949.description: Abstract Data is replicated and stored redundantly over multiple servers for availability in distributed databases. We focus on databases with frequent reads and writes, where both read and write latencies are important. This is in contrast to databases designed primarily for either read or write applications. Redundancy has contrasting effects on read and write latency.

arxiv-2203-15363.title: Nonlinear dynamics of topological helicity wave in a frustrated skyrmion string
arxiv-2203-15363.creator: Jing Xia, Xichao Zhang, Xiaoxi Liu, Yan Zhou, Motohiko Ezawa
arxiv-2203-15363.description: Abstract A skyrmion in frustrated magnetic system has the helicity degree of freedom. A skyrmion string is formed in a frustrated layered system, which is well described by the X ​ Y XY model owing to the exchange coupling between adjacent layers.

arxiv-2207-04112.title: Cohomology of manifolds with structure group U ⁡ ( n ) × O ⁡ ( s ) U(n)\times O(s)
arxiv-2207-04112.creator: Paweł Raźny
arxiv-2207-04112.description: Abstract . We introduce a new spectral sequence for the study of 𝒦 \mathcal{K} -manifolds which arises by restricting the spectral sequence of a Riemannian foliation to forms invariant under the flows of { ξ 1 , … , ξ s } \{\xi_{1},...,\xi_{s}\} .

arxiv-2209-13150.title: Interaction of the Primitive Equations with Sea Ice Dynamics
arxiv-2209-13150.creator: Tim Binz, Felix Brandt, Matthias Hieber
arxiv-2209-13150.description: Abstract . This article establishes local strong well-posedness and global strong well-posedness close to constant equilibria of a model coupling the primitive equations of ocean and atmospheric dynamics with Hibler’s viscous-plastic sea ice model. In order to treat the coupling conditions, an approach involving the hydrostatic Dirichlet and Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator is developed.

arxiv-2310-01165.title: Towards guarantees for parameter isolation in continual learning
arxiv-2310-01165.creator: Giulia Lanzillotta, Sidak Pal Singh & Thomas Hofmann, Benjamin F. Grewe
arxiv-2310-01165.description: Abstract Deep learning has proved to be a successful paradigm for solving many challenges in machine learning. However, deep neural networks fail when trained sequentially on multiple tasks, a shortcoming known as catastrophic forgetting in the continual learning literature. Despite a recent flourish of learning algorithms successfully addressing this problem, we find that provable guarantees against catastrophic forgetting are lacking.

arxiv-2310-17694.title: Where do stars explode in the ISM? – The distribution of dense gas around massive stars and supernova remnants in M33 Facilities: VLA, ALMA, Mayall, UKIRT CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2022 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , num
arxiv-2310-17694.creator: Sumit K. Sarbadhicary, Jordan Wagner, Eric W. Koch, Ness Mayker Chen, Adam K. Leroy, Natalia Lahén, Erik Rosolowsky, Kathryn F. Neugent, Chang-Goo Kim, Laura Chomiuk, Julianne J. Dalcanton, Laura A. Lopez, Nickolas M. Pingel, Remy Indebetouw, Thomas G. Williams, Elizabeth Tarantino, Jennifer Donovan
arxiv-2310-17694.description: Abstract Star formation in galaxies is regulated by turbulence, outflows, gas heating and cloud dispersal – processes which depend sensitively on the properties of the interstellar medium (ISM) into which supernovae (SNe) explode. Unfortunately, direct measurements of ISM environments around SNe remain scarce, as SNe are rare and often distant.

arxiv-2404-01356.title: The Double-Edged Sword of Input Perturbations to Robust Accurate Fairness
arxiv-2404-01356.description: Abstract Deep neural networks (DNNs) are known to be sensitive to adversarial input perturbations, leading to a reduction in either prediction accuracy or individual fairness. To jointly characterize the susceptibility of prediction accuracy and individual fairness to adversarial perturbations, we introduce a novel robustness definition termed robust accurate fairness .

arxiv-2405-02558.title: The open string pair production revisited
arxiv-2405-02558.creator: J. X. Lu
arxiv-2405-02558.description: Abstract The experimental efforts in testing the QED vacuum properties such as the Schwinger pair production in the presence of a strong electric field have so far not been successful. This raises a potential possibility regarding if the usual QED vacuum picture is a complete one.

arxiv-2407-16724.title: Structure-aware Domain Knowledge Injection for Large Language Models
arxiv-2407-16724.creator: Kai Liu, Ze Chen, Zhihang Fu, Wei Zhang, Rongxin Jiang, Fan Zhou, Yaowu Chen, Yue Wu, Jieping Ye
arxiv-2407-16724.description: Abstract This paper introduces a pioneering methodology, termed StructTuning , to efficiently transform foundation Large Language Models (LLMs) into domain specialists. It significantly reduces the training corpus needs to a mere 5% while achieving an impressive 100% of traditional knowledge injection performance.

arxiv-2407-21223.title: A Trek Rule for the Lyapunov Equation
arxiv-2407-21223.creator: Niels Richard Hansen
arxiv-2407-21223.description: Abstract . The Lyapunov equation is a linear matrix equation characterizing the cross-sectional steady-state covariance matrix of a Gaussian Markov process. We show a new version of the trek rule for this equation, which links the graphical structure of the drift of the process to the entries of the steady-state covariance matrix.

arxiv-2505-20959.title: Research Community Perspectives on “Intelligence” and Large Language Models
arxiv-2505-20959.creator: Bertram Højer, Terne Sasha Thorn Jakobsen, Anna Rogers, Stefan Heinrich
arxiv-2505-20959.description: Abstract Despite the widespread use of “artificial intelligence” (AI) framing in Natural Language Processing (NLP) research, it is not clear what researchers mean by “intelligence”. To that end, we present the results of a survey on the notion of “intelligence” among researchers and its role in the research agenda.

arxiv-2602-03475.title: On the uniform dimension of subextensions in skew polynomial rings
arxiv-2602-03475.creator: BertrandNguefack
arxiv-2602-03475.description: Abstract . This work investigates the invariance of the non-necessarily finite uniform dimension and related concepts for subextensions in skew polynomial rings 𝕊 = R ⁡ [ X ; α , δ ] \mathbb{S}=R[\mathbf{\mathrm{X}};\mathbf{\alpha},\mathbf{\delta}] of bijective type over a well-ordered set of variables.

pmc-12517426.title: “I am trapped in my body”: a qualitative exploration of bodily experiences during brace treatment among adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis
pmc-12517426.creator: Marit Fure, Kristine Risum, Lena Fauske, Hedda Eik
pmc-12517426.description: PurposeAdolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) is a spinal deformity that often requires long-term bracing to prevent the progression of spinal curvature. However, bracing impacts several aspects of adolescents’ lives. This study explores the bodily experiences of adolescents with AIS while receiving brace treatment.

pmc-12539453.title: Effect of Semaglutide on Epicardial Adipogenesis and hiPSC-Atrial Cardiomyocytes New Hope in Targeting Epicardial Adipose Tissue
pmc-12539453.creator: Bénédicte Gaborit
pmc-12539453.description: Corresponding AuthorKey Words: adipogenesis, epicardial fat, metabolism, semaglutide The accumulation of epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) around the heart, particularly in patients with cardiovascular disease, and its degree of inflammation has emerged as a key risk factor linked to adverse cardiac outcomes.

pmc-12585638.title: Structural insights of anti-MHC-I monoclonal antibodies that block NK cell receptor interactions with tumors
pmc-12585638.creator: Jiansheng Jiang, Kannan Natarajan, Abir Panda, Lisa F. Boyd, Reanne Towler, Haotian Lei, Rick Huang, Ethan M. Shevach, David H. Margulies
pmc-12585638.description: We have recently shown that certain anti-MHC-I mAbs in human and murine systems can stimulate immune responses to tumors and infections by competitively blocking inhibitory signals delivered by MHC-I-specific inhibitory receptors of several inflammatory cell types [1,2]. To understand such functions, we determined the structure of a broadly reactive anti-human MHC-I mAb, B1.23.

pmc-12590553.title: Advanced intensity-modulated fiber sensors for scalable sensing
pmc-12590553.creator: Filip Malinka, Ondrej Vachek, Daniel Krizan, Jiri Stipal, Carlos Marques, Petr Siska, Jan Nedoma
pmc-12590553.description: SummaryIntensity-modulated fiber optic sensors (IM-FOSs) represent a cost-effective and structurally simple alternative to phase-based and wavelength-based optical sensors. Their operational principle enables the development of robust, scalable, and multiplexable systems suitable for a wide range of mechanical measurements. This review provides a structured overview of IM-FOS technologies, highlighting recent developments in architectures, interrogation methods, and application domains.

pmc-12635711.title: Potentially novel surrogate biomarker for diagnosing insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes
pmc-12635711.creator: Helen Jiang, David Henley, Fang-Xu Jiang
pmc-12635711.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity are growing global pandemics that shares the common characteristic of insulin resistance (IR). IR leads to progressive β-cell failure, worsening T2DM and its cardiovascular complications. Thus, early diagnosis of IR is important to prevent and reverse β-cell dedifferentiation.

pmc-13652375.title: Frozen autograft–prosthesis composite reconstruction with total hip arthroplasty for proximal femoral osteosarcoma: a case report
pmc-13652375.creator: Viet Nhuan Ngo, Phuoc Hung Do, Quang Vinh Pham, Hoang Phu Nguyen, Ba Vu Dong Phan
pmc-13652375.description: Introduction and importance:Reconstruction after proximal femoral resection requires restoration of both a large osseous defect and stable hip joint function. Frozen autograft–prosthesis composite (FAPC) reconstruction using liquid nitrogen-treated autograft represents a viable biological option for this indication. We present a case of proximal femoral osteosarcoma managed with this technique.
